probe.protocol: features are the body's own [16,8] column tokens; standardize by train mean/std; ridge fit on all train256 column tokens, test on fit32 column tokens; one class per column

baseline_check.meaning: the probe code path must reproduce the P3.30 pre-flight number before any training reading is interpreted

aux.form: per-column six-way cross-entropy whose logits are the negative squared distances from each column token to the six palette prototypes, tau fixed at 1.0
aux.supervised: columns occupied by exactly one palette colour, from the public locator
aux.excluded: columns claimed by two colours (ambiguous) and background columns
aux.prototypes: recomputed every step from the current encoder and detached; reference geometry, never a gradient path

criteria.single_variable: against P3.30 only encoder.rgb unfreezes and receives the column auxiliary; the 59-parameter readout, data, order, doses, batch, optimizer and query-colour head are unchanged; no new parameter is created
criteria.trainable: encoder.rgb (392 parameters) plus the P3.30 readout (59 parameters); every other body tensor is frozen

ladder.column_supervision_collapsed: override, checked first: prototype pairwise min distance < 1e-4 and the auxiliary loss within 0.01 of log 6 at the final dose

consequences.pathway_unlocked: the observation pathway is unblocked; a 22.5 parent attempt becomes priceable and goes to the owner as a yes/no
consequences.task_carries_probe_lags: same consequence; the probe gate was miscalibrated as a necessary condition and is reported as descriptive
consequences.colour_learned_task_blocked: the encoder is alive but the remaining blocker is readout-side; owner decision before any further readout variant
consequences.encoder_dead_on_this_task: 22.6 stays sealed with a named negative result; no further readout variants
consequences.column_supervision_collapsed: this auxiliary design is structurally degenerate; the encoder-supervision route closes and 22.6 stays sealed

control_arms.p3_30_frozen_encoder: same readout, encoder frozen: fit 0.3125, colour 0.8125, column hits 1/24, probe fit 0.674
control_arms.p3_28_pixels: same readout on raw pixels: fit 0.9688, colour 1.000

note: pricing stage; run requires frozen status plus owner authority plus a measured cap; a trial mode exists to catch a degenerate auxiliary before freezing and writes nothing

trial.note: aux below log 6 and probe rising; no collapse; prototypes dipped to 0.0002 at step 400 and recovered

authorization.asked: 是否授权跑 22.5.P4.1 列级颜色监督（预计 ≤80 CPU，先定价再冻结）
authorization.scope: single-seed single-variable card, 7376 steps, measured cap 127.6 CPU
authorization.note: the owner granted the priced yes/no from the 22.6 entry card
